rules.brand: longest catalog brand (lowercased, & -> +, ' by H-E-B' stripped) found as whole words in the query, excluding not_brands
rules.category_confusion: >= 3 of top 10 in a level-2 category holding none of the query's relevant (label >= 1) items
rules.reach: each relevant item outside the hybrid top 10: hybrid rank 11-30, 31-50; beyond hybrid 50 but within BM25-only top 50 (fusion_bm25); beyond both but within semantic-only top 50, same model (fusion_semantic_only); or unreachable
